results.name: Retail Shelf System - Basic Parts
results.description:
Basic retail shelf system

There is a lot of parts. I used both the world grid snapping and some parts you are snapping to other meshes edges (once you figure them out, its easy)

2 materials are used, 1 for the textures, and 1 for the transparent part of the edge strips for labels.

File contains Textures in 2048x2048 and 4096x4096 comes with Basecolor, Metallic, Roughness and Opacity maps

FBX and OBJ version of the scene containing all parts seperated
***(Strongly advised to use the FBX version to keep the pivot point for easy snapping, the OBJ. has the same files, but looses the original pivot point)***

License under CC Attribution: Feel free to download and use it as you like in any projects.

It would warm my ice-cold 3D heart for credit of the work if used in projects.

results.name: High-Poly Gondola Shelf Unit — Retail Display
results.description:
A detailed, realistic gondola shelving unit modeled after standard convenience store and supermarket center-aisle fixtures, with fully modeled perforated holes throughout the back wall and shelf decks — real geometry, not faked with textures.

Features:

Fully modeled perforated back wall and shelf holes (real geometry)
Detailed peg-hook attachment points along the back wall
Standard real-world sizing, so multiple units can be placed side by side to form longer gondola runs/aisles
Clean, evenly spaced shelf layout typical of real-world gondola systems
Accurate proportions based on real retail shelving standards
Simple 2-piece structure split by material, for easy setup and material editing

Specs:

~233k triangles
Modeled in Blender
2 objects (split by material)

Ideal for retail environment scenes, store interior visualizations, product placement renders, or archviz projects needing an authentic convenience store aisle look.

results.name: Wooden Retail Display Stand
results.description:
Wooden Retail Display Stand measuring 1640mm in height, 2440mm in width, and 
350 & 500mm in depth. This retail display shelving unit is constructed entirely from 
plywood, making it an excellent choice for showcasing small items near a checkout 
area, such as souvenirs, jewelry, medium-sized products, and more.

The unit is equipped with two internal fixed shelves positioned 300mm above the 
desk cabinet. The space above is divided with side panels and a longitudinal panel, 
providing the necessary support to prevent shelf bending.

results.name: Grocery Shelf 3D Scan with Artec Leo 3D Scanner
results.description: What's amazing about a 3D scanner is its ability to capture a 3D digital copy of real-life objects quickly and accurately. 3D scanning can be used for product visualization such as for e-commerce, as well as retail and grocery stores who want to document products on shelfs for merchandising purposes. This is a proof of concept where we scanned merchandise on a shelf using the Artec Leo 3D scanner. For more information on this handheld 3D scanner, please visit: https://gomeasure3d.com/artec-3d-scanners/leo/.
